title: Now Live: Slash Payment Processing
summary: Slash Payment Processing lets businesses accept card payments on invoices or through an embedded checkout, with payouts and balances in one dashboard.
body_markdown:
## Get paid with Slash


Today, we’re introducing[Slash Payment Processing](https://www.slash.com/products/payment-processing) : a new way for businesses to accept card payments directly through Slash.


With Slash Payment Processing, you can let customers pay Slash invoices by card, add secure checkout components to your own checkout, follow payments from purchase to payout, and manage your incoming revenue activity from the Slash dashboard.


Payment processing directly connects the money coming into your business with the tools you already use to manage it, including your accounts, cards, accounting software, cash-flow tools, and more.¹


## Choose how you want to accept payments


Your business can use Slash Payment Processing in two ways: add card payments to your invoices or build Slash into your existing checkout with the Slash SDK and Payment Elements.


### Let customers pay invoices by card


Slash already helps you create and send professional invoices, track outstanding balances, and reconcile incoming funds. Now, you can also give customers the option to pay those invoices by card.


When a customer pays, Slash automatically connects the transaction to the correct invoice. You get an up-to-date view of what you’ve collected without manually matching records across different platforms.


Card payments are another option for your invoices, not a replacement: you can still use Slash invoicing to get paid by wire, ACH, direct debit, or stablecoin.⁴


### Add Slash to your own checkout


Slash Payment Processing lets businesses accept card payments directly within their own website. Payment Elements, delivered through Slash’s React SDK, provides the secure, prebuilt payment components needed to add card and supported wallet entry to an existing checkout.


You control the surrounding customer experience, including:


- Checkout layout and design
- Customer information
- Order details
- The steps customers take before and after payment


Slash securely handles card entry and additional verification, including 3-D Secure when required. Payment updates help you connect each transaction to the correct order in your own systems.


To learn more about implementing the Slash SDK and Payment Elements into your website’s checkout,[read our quickstart guide and additional documentation for more information](https://docs.slash.com/docs/payments/quickstart) .


## Slash is the merchant of record


Slash Payment Processing is a managed merchant-of-record solution. Slash is the legal seller on the transaction and holds the underlying processing relationships, so you don't apply for, set up, or manage merchant identification numbers, and you don't hold a separate merchant account.


Sales tax is the exception. You remain responsible for calculating, filing, and remitting all applicable sales taxes on your sales.


You can accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express transactions, with more supported payment methods coming soon. Customers can also checkout using Apple Pay and Google Pay. USD and EUR are generally available to eligible business; CAD, GBP, and AUD can be available on request.


## Connect your revenue with the rest of your finances


Payments collected through invoices and custom checkouts appear together in Slash. You can quickly see what you’ve collected, what’s still processing, and when funds are available.


More importantly, that information is connected to the tools you use to manage the rest of your business. You can:


- Understand how sales are affecting your cash flow
- Keep your books up to date through accounting integrations
- Move funds into your Slash operating or treasury account⁶
- Explore financing options to help manage slower seasons⁵


Instead of exporting reports from your processor and piecing together an analysis yourself, you can see the complete picture of your finances and put your funds to work in one place.


### [Start collecting customer payments today with Slash](https://www.slash.com/products/payment-processing)


Payment processing is now available in your Slash dashboard. Select **Payment Processing** under the **Revenue** tab to get started.


Availability is subject to eligibility and compliance review and may vary based on your business location, industry, and business model. We may ask you to provide additional information before you can begin processing payments.


## Apply in less than 10 minutes today


Join the 10,000+ businesses already using Slash.
